terms.content: Terms of use for the M4SH platform

s1.title: 1. General Provisions
s1.body:
This User Agreement (hereinafter — "Agreement") governs the terms of use of the M4SH platform (hereinafter — "Platform"), provided by FOP Oleksandr Mashmaniuk (hereinafter — "M4SH", "we").

By using the Platform, you confirm that you have read this Agreement and agree to its terms. If you do not agree — please do not use the Platform.

Beta version. The Platform is currently in closed beta testing and is provided "as is". Features may change without prior notice.

s2.title: 2. Definitions
s2.body:
• Platform — the M4SH web service (m4sh.org), an educational operating system for tutors and schools
  • User — an individual who has registered and uses the Platform
  • Tutor — a user who provides educational services through the Platform
  • Student / Learner — a user who receives educational services
  • Subscription — a paid subscription plan for access to Platform features

s3.title: 3. What M4SH Is — and What It Is NOT
s3.body:
M4SH is a SaaS platform (Software as a Service). We provide tutors and schools with tools for conducting online lessons: an interactive whiteboard, Replay (saving the course of a session on the board — actions and strokes, not video), chat, student invitations, and analytics.

M4SH is not an intermediary in financial relations between tutors and students. The Platform does not process, hold, or transfer funds between users. Any financial settlements between a tutor and a student for educational services are made directly between them and are not subject to this Agreement.

Payment for an M4SH subscription is solely payment for access to Platform features, not payment for educational services.

s4.title: 4. Registration and Accounts
s4.body:
To use the Platform, you must create an account. You agree to provide accurate and current information during registration and to keep it up to date.

You are fully responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your password and for all actions taken through your account.

Transferring your account to other persons is prohibited.

s5.title: 5. Rules of Use
s5.body:
By using the Platform, you agree to:

  • Use the Platform only for lawful purposes
  • Not violate the rights of other users
  • Not post false, offensive, discriminatory, or illegal content
  • Not attempt to gain unauthorized access to Platform systems
  • Not use automated tools to collect data without our permission
  • Comply with all applicable laws of Ukraine and the EU

Prohibited content categories: fraud, pornography, child sexual abuse material (CSAM), hate speech, illegal activities.

s6.title: 6. Right to Restrict Access and Block Accounts
s6.body:
M4SH reserves the right at any time, without prior notice and without obligation to explain reasons:

  • Temporarily suspend or permanently block an account
  • Remove any content posted by a user
  • Restrict access to certain features

Grounds for blocking: violation of this Agreement, suspicion of fraud, complaints from other users, legal requirements. Upon blocking, unused subscription balance may be refunded at the administration's discretion.

s7.title: 7. Paid Services and Subscriptions
s7.body:
Some Platform features are available under a paid subscription. Current prices are shown on the subscription page. Payment is processed through the Plata by mono payment system in accordance with its terms.

Subscriptions automatically renew at the end of each paid period. You may cancel renewal at any time in your account settings — cancellation takes effect after the current paid period ends.

s8.title: 8. Intellectual Property
s8.body:
All rights to the Platform — design, source code, logos, trademarks, content — belong to M4SH or to third parties who have granted a license. You are not granted any rights to M4SH intellectual property, other than the right to use the Platform in accordance with this Agreement.

Content you create and upload to the Platform (lessons, recordings, materials) remains your property. You grant M4SH a non-exclusive license to store and technically display this content for the purpose of providing Platform services.

s9.title: 9. Limitation of Liability
s9.body:
The Platform is provided "as is" without any express or implied warranties, including warranties of fitness for a particular purpose, uninterrupted operation, or freedom from errors.

M4SH is not liable for:

  • Damages resulting from temporary Platform unavailability
  • The quality of educational services provided by tutors
  • Disputes between tutors and students regarding lesson payments
  • Data loss due to circumstances beyond our control
  • Actions of third parties, including cyberattacks

M4SH's maximum liability to you in any case shall not exceed the amount paid by you for a subscription over the last 12 months.

s10.title: 10. Jurisdiction and Dispute Resolution
s10.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of Ukraine. In the event of disputes, the parties agree to first resolve them through negotiations by contacting support@m4sh.org. If negotiations are unsuccessful, the dispute shall be referred to the appropriate court of Ukraine.

s11.title: 11. Changes to the Agreement

s1.title: 1. Who Processes Your Data
s1.body:
Data controller: FOP Oleksandr Mashmaniuk, Ukraine.
Contact: support@m4sh.org

This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it when you use the M4SH Platform (m4sh.org).

s2.title: 2. What Data We Collect
s2.body:
Data you provide directly:

  • First name, last name, email address (upon registration)
  • Phone number (for SMS verification, optional)
  • Profile information: photo, description, subjects, prices (for tutors)
  • Payment data — processed exclusively by payment systems (we do not store card numbers)
  • Content you create: lesson materials, whiteboard recordings, chat messages

Data collected automatically:

  • IP address, browser type, operating system
  • Action logs: which features were used, session times
  • Technical metrics for monitoring platform stability

s3.title: 3. Why We Use Your Data
s3.body:
• Providing Platform features (authentication, on-board session replay, student invitations)
  • Processing subscriptions and payments
  • Sending transactional emails (registration confirmation, password recovery, payment notifications)
  • Technical support and responses to your requests
  • Detecting and preventing fraud
  • Analyzing and improving features (in aggregated/anonymized form)
  • Fulfilling legal obligations

s4.title: 4. Replay — Saving the Course of a Session
s4.body:
M4SH Classroom has a technical function for saving the course of a session (Replay). A tutor can activate recording of the sequence of actions on the teaching whiteboard for later review by participants.

Replay is not a video or audio recording. Your appearance and voice are not captured in Replay. In nature, Replay is similar to "Version History" in Google Docs or Figma — actions on the board are saved, not video.

What is saved in Replay: the sequence of actions on the board (drawing, text, moving elements, page changes), attribution of each action to a participant, timestamps and session metadata. The textual content of the board and identity attribution constitute personal data of participants.

Notification of active Replay: if the tutor has activated Replay — the platform displays an informational message to you during the session.

Access to Replay: the tutor determines the access level after the session (tutor only / by link / public). M4SH may access Replay exclusively for technical support or pursuant to a legal request.

Storage and deletion:

  • Replay is stored until deleted by the tutor
  • After being moved to the trash — deleted within 7 days
  • Upon deactivation of the tutor's account — all Replays are deleted

Your rights regarding Replay:

  • View Replay via a link from the tutor
  • Contact support@m4sh.org regarding deletion of a Replay in which you participated

Sessions with minors: for students under 14 years old, the Platform restricts Replay visibility (private only by default). The tutor is obligated to notify parents/guardians about active Replay.

Use for AI training: Replay data is not used for artificial intelligence training without separate explicit consent of the participants. Prohibited by default.

s5.title: 5. Sharing Data with Third Parties
s5.body:
We share data only with services necessary for the Platform to operate:

  • Plata by mono — processing subscription payments. Card data is transferred directly to the payment system and is not stored on our servers.
  • Fly.io — hosting for the server-side of the Platform.
  • Cloudflare R2 — storage of user files (images, PDFs, whiteboard materials).
  • Sentry (sentry.io) — monitoring of technical errors (may contain technical request context).
  • Gmail / Google Workspace — sending transactional emails via no-reply@m4sh.org.
  • Twilio — SMS verification of phone numbers (optional).
  • Telegram — technical notifications for administrators.

We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes. Data is shared with law enforcement only upon a lawful request.

s6.title: 6. Data Retention
s6.body:
We retain your data for as long as necessary to provide services and fulfill legal obligations:

  • Account data — until account deletion + 30 days
  • Replay (whiteboard actions) — until deleted by the tutor; after being moved to the trash — deleted within 7 days. See Section 4 for details.
  • Educational materials and whiteboard content — until deleted by you or upon account deletion
  • Payment history — 5 years (legal requirements)
  • Technical logs — 90 days

s7.title: 7. Minor Users
s7.body:
M4SH serves both adult and minor students. Tutors on the Platform must be at least 18 years old.

For students under 14 years old, registration is made through a parental or guardian account. We do not collect personal data from children under 14 without confirmed parental or guardian consent.

Parents and guardians may contact support@m4sh.org to:

  • View data stored about their child
  • Delete the child's account and all associated data
  • Withdraw consent to data processing

s8.title: 8. Your Rights (GDPR)
s8.body:
Under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Ukrainian law, you have the right to:

  • Access — obtain a copy of your personal data (request via support@m4sh.org)
  • Rectification — update inaccurate data in your profile
  • Erasure — fully delete your account and data (Settings → Privacy)
  • Restriction of processing — restrict data processing in certain cases
  • Objection — object to processing based on legitimate interests
  • Portability — receive your data in a machine-readable format

To exercise your rights, contact: support@m4sh.org. Response time — up to 30 days.

s9.title: 9. Cookies
s9.body:
We use technically necessary cookies for authentication (the JWT token is stored in an httpOnly cookie). These cookies cannot be disabled without losing access to the Platform.

We do not use advertising cookies and do not track you across other websites.

s10.title: 10. Data Security
s10.body:
We apply technical and organizational measures to protect your data: HTTPS/TLS encryption, httpOnly cookies, CSRF protection, rate limiting, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and anomalous activity monitoring.

In the event of a data breach that could cause harm, we will notify you within 72 hours (in accordance with GDPR Article 33–34 requirements).

s11.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
s11.body: We may update this Policy. In the event of significant changes, we will notify you via email or a notification within the Platform. Continued use after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the new version.

s12.title: 12. Contact
s12.body:
For privacy and data protection questions:
Email: support@m4sh.org

s1.title: 1. General Payment Terms
s1.body: These Payment Terms govern the process of making payments for the use of paid services of the M4SH Platform.

s2.title: 2. Pricing Plans
s2.body:
The Platform offers various pricing plans with different features. Current prices and terms are shown on the subscription page.

Prices are listed in Ukrainian hryvnias (UAH) or US dollars (USD) depending on the selected payment method.

s3.title: 3. Payment Methods

By making a payment, you agree to the terms of the selected payment system.

s4.title: 4. Automatic Subscription Renewal
s4.body:
Subscriptions automatically renew at the end of each billing period (monthly or annually). Payment is automatically charged to your card.

You may cancel automatic renewal at any time in your subscription settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid period.

s5.title: 5. Changing Your Pricing Plan

You may change your pricing plan at any time:

  • Upgrading to a higher plan — changes take effect immediately, the price difference is calculated on a pro-rata basis
  • Downgrading to a lower plan — changes take effect from the next billing period

s6.title: 6. Payment Security
s6.body:
All payments are processed through secure payment systems using SSL/TLS encryption.

We do not store your full payment card details on our servers. All payment information is processed directly by the payment systems.

s7.title: 7. Taxes
s7.body: The seller is a single-tax payer (group 3, 5% rate) and is not a VAT payer. Prices are listed without VAT. Additional taxes may apply depending on your jurisdiction.

s0.title: Summary
s0.body: M4SH is a technology platform, not an employer. You provide educational services to students independently, on your own terms. We provide the tools: whiteboard, chat, Replay (playback of the session's actions on the board), and student invitations. A subscription is the only form of monetization between you and M4SH.

s1.title: I. Definitions
s1.body:
Administrator — FOP Oleksandr Mashmaniuk, owner and operator of the M4SH Platform.
M4SH Platform — a technological educational platform at m4sh.org: classroom (whiteboard, chat), Replay, student invitations, scheduling, materials library.
Tutor — an individual aged 18 or older who has registered a tutor account and provides educational services to students through the Platform.
Student — a Platform user who contacts tutors for educational services.
Educational Services — lessons, consultations, and other forms of educational interaction between a Tutor and a Student.
Replay — a saved sequence of actions on the teaching whiteboard during a session (not an audio or video recording).
Subscription — a SaaS agreement between the Tutor and the Administrator for access to Platform features (FREE / PRO / BUSINESS).
Acceptance Right — the technical ability to confirm one Request from a Student within the pricing plan.

s2.title: IIA. Platform Status — Role Limitations
s2.body:
M4SH is NOT and does NOT act as:

  • An employer or contractor — the relationship is not an employment relationship. The Tutor independently determines methodology, schedule, prices, and terms of service delivery.
  • A party to the agreement between the Tutor and the Student — any agreement regarding educational services is concluded exclusively between the Tutor and the Student.
  • A payment agent or intermediary — the Platform does not accept or transfer funds in settlements between the Tutor and the Student for lessons.
  • An educational institution — M4SH does not provide educational services, does not issue diplomas, and is not subject to education legislation.
  • A guarantor of learning outcomes — the Platform is not responsible for the quality or effectiveness of the Tutor's educational services.

The Tutor retains the right to simultaneously provide educational services through any other platforms or directly. The Tutor is independently responsible for providing technical means to work.

s3.title: V. SaaS Subscription
s3.body:
The Administrator monetizes the Platform exclusively through the Tutor's SaaS subscription. The Administrator does not take any percentage of the cost of educational services.

Current pricing is on the m4sh.org/pricing page. Payment is via Plata by mono. The subscription automatically renews; a reminder is sent 5 days before the charge. Grace period for failed payment — 3 days.

Acceptance Right — this is a technical capability of the Platform, not electronic money, prepaid credits, or a financial instrument. Acceptance rights have no monetary equivalent, are not subject to cash refund, and are cancelled upon subscription cancellation (this is clearly stated before payment).

s4.title: VIA. Financial Settlements for Educational Services
s4.body: M4SH does not participate in financial settlements between the Tutor and the Student for educational services. The Administrator does not accept, store, or transfer funds for lessons; is not a merchant of record, escrow agent, or guarantor. Settlements are exclusively between the Tutor and the Student by any means agreed upon between them.

s5.title: VIB. Replay — Saving the Course of a Session
s5.body:
Classroom provides the technical ability to save the sequence of actions on the whiteboard (Replay). Replay is not an audio or video recording. It is closer to "Version History" in Google Docs: actions (drawing, text, files) are saved, not video or voice.

By activating Replay, the Tutor confirms that they have notified the Student about the session being recorded. The Tutor determines the access level for Replay (private / by link / public). Replay with minor participants requires parental notification.

Using Replay for AI training is prohibited without separate explicit consent from both participants. Replay is stored until deleted by the Tutor; after being moved to the trash, it is deleted within 7 days.

s6.title: VII. Minor Students
s6.body:
Tutors on the Platform must be at least 18 years old. When working with students under 18, the Tutor is obligated to: ensure parental permission for online learning exists; notify parents about Replay; not collect personal data of minors outside the Platform.

In the event of a complaint regarding the safety of a minor, the Administrator has the right to immediately suspend the Tutor's access pending investigation.

s7.title: IX. Intellectual Property
s7.body: The Tutor's content (photos, materials, tests, whiteboard content) remains the Tutor's property. By posting content on the Platform, the Tutor grants M4SH a narrow non-exclusive license solely for the functioning of the Platform (display, storage, indexing within the Platform). Marketing use — only with separate explicit consent from the Tutor.

s8.title: XII. Liability and XIII. Final Provisions
s8.body:
The Administrator's liability for technical failures of the Platform is limited to the cost of the subscription for the last 3 months (except for intent or gross negligence).

The Agreement is governed by the laws of Ukraine. Pre-litigation procedure — 30 days. Current version: m4sh.org/legal/tutor-offer.
Contact: support@m4sh.org

s1.title: I. Definitions
s1.body:
Platform — the set of M4SH software tools (m4sh.org): classroom, teaching whiteboard, chat, and practice tools.
Administrator — FOP Oleksandr Mashmaniuk, Ukraine.

Tutor — an independent specialist registered under the terms of the Tutor Agreement.

s2.title: II. Acceptance of the Agreement
s2.body:
Registering an account on m4sh.org constitutes full acceptance of this Agreement and the Privacy Policy.

For persons under 14 years old, registration is made exclusively through a parental or guardian account (Art. 32 of the Civil Code of Ukraine). Parents/guardians bear full responsibility for the minor's use of the Platform.

s3.title: IIA. Platform Role — Important
s3.body:
M4SH is NOT and does NOT act as:

  • A party to the agreement between the Student and the Tutor — the terms of learning, price, and format are determined exclusively by the Student and the Tutor between themselves.
  • A payment intermediary — the Platform does not accept or transfer funds for educational services.
  • An educational institution — M4SH does not issue educational documents and is not responsible for tutors' pedagogical qualifications.
  • A guarantor of learning outcomes — progress depends on the Student's efforts and the Tutor's methodology.
  • Responsible for the Tutor's actions — the Tutor is responsible for the quality of lessons and fulfillment of agreements.

s4.title: V. Payment and Financial Matters
s4.body:
Payment for educational services is made directly between the Student and the Tutor and does not pass through M4SH. Financial disputes are resolved exclusively between the Student and the Tutor without the Administrator's involvement.

Paid Platform features (if any) are paid via Plata by mono to M4SH and are governed separately.

s5.title: VI. Replay — Session Progress on the Whiteboard
s5.body:
The Tutor may activate saving of the sequence of actions on the teaching whiteboard (Replay). Replay is not an audio or video recording. Actions on the whiteboard (drawing, text, files) are saved, not the appearance or voice of participants. This is similar to "Version History" in Google Docs.

If the tutor has activated Replay — the Platform displays an informational message to you during the session.

The Tutor determines the access level for Replay: private (tutor only), by link, or public. If you wish to delete a Replay in which you participated — contact support@m4sh.org.

Replay data is not used for AI training without separate explicit consent from participants.

s6.title: VII. Protection of Minors
s6.body:
Registration age:

  • 18 and older — independent registration
  • 14–17 years — independent registration; parents/guardians must be informed
  • Under 14 years — registration exclusively through a parental/guardian account

M4SH does not collect personal data from children under 14 without confirmed parental or guardian consent. Parents and guardians may contact support@m4sh.org to view, update, or delete a child's data.

If you or your child have encountered unacceptable behavior from a tutor — report it immediately via support@m4sh.org.

s7.title: VIII. Student Rights and Obligations
s7.body:
The Student agrees to: provide accurate data upon registration; not violate the tutor's copyright on materials; not distribute Replay without the tutor's explicit written consent; not use the Platform for illegal purposes.

The Student has the right to: obtain a copy of their personal data (request via support@m4sh.org); delete the account with all data (Settings → Privacy); file a complaint against a tutor through support.

s8.title: XII. Personal Data and XIII. Dispute Resolution
s8.body:
Personal data processing is governed by the Privacy Policy. Requests: support@m4sh.org (response within 30 days).

Complaint to M4SH: support@m4sh.org, review period — 30 days. Consumer rights under the Law of Ukraine "On Consumer Rights Protection" take priority over the terms of this Agreement. Law of Ukraine.
